canonical_title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
abstract: Combines VLM zone planning, diffusion-based furniture layouts, and geometric compilation to create simulation-ready indoor scenes.
screening_reason: Relevant scene authoring; the inspected repair stage uses fixed geometric operators rather than an established feedback-driven model revision loop.

screening_evidence.evidence: A VLM plans zones and extracts relations. Geometry fitting and relation-specific local corrections produce the scene.

contribution: Combines VLM zone planning, diffusion-based furniture layouts, and geometric compilation to create simulation-ready indoor scenes.
limitations: Scope needs review. Simulation-ready geometry alone is not dynamic authoring.

canonical_title: GenXR-Bench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive XR Development
abstract: Tests coding agents on 112 XR development tasks, including application creation and repairs, with simulated interactions and visual or programmatic checks.
screening_reason: An evaluation benchmark for interactive XR authoring, not one graphics-generation method.

screening_evidence.evidence: Tasks supply instructions, editable XR Blocks projects, assets and documentation; a separate held-out suite evaluates behavior.

contribution: Tests coding agents on 112 XR development tasks, including application creation and repairs, with simulated interactions and visual or programmatic checks.
limitations: Held-out evaluation checks must not be mistaken for feedback available to the coding agent.

canonical_title: StackGen3D: Stable 3D Block Stack Generation from Multiview Silhouettes
abstract: Generates stable block arrangements with a learned stability predictor and conditional flow matching.
screening_reason: The abstract describes a generative model with geometric refinement, not a language-model agent directing graphics actions.

screening_evidence.evidence: PI-GNN curates stable examples, and flow matching generates block configurations.

contribution: Generates stable block arrangements with a learned stability predictor and conditional flow matching.
